title: Monitoring of hold-open devices and closers.
officialText: All hold-open devices used in automatic-closing doors pursuant to the exception to Section 708.7 shall be electrically supervised to monitor the integrity of the wiring connections among the fire alarm system, the smoke detection system, and the hold-open devices.
